item.name: protect Lambda retries with Powertools Idempotency
item.summary: A private Worker preview runs the actual Powertools idempotency helper with a local AWS SDK DynamoDB command fixture; it makes no AWS calls.

manifest.original_contribution: Original, focused Node.js Lambda integration module for DynamoDB-backed idempotency for business events using the pinned AWS Powertools TypeScript package.

delivery_contract.format: self-contained JSON with exact UTF-8 file contents
delivery_contract.side_effects: The private bounded preview runs only local product behavior and fixtures; buyer deployment may perform AWS service calls as documented.

manifest.supported_boundary: A Node.js Lambda helper using the actual Powertools DynamoDB persistence layer. Private preview runs it against a fixed in-memory AWS SDK command fixture; no DynamoDB or AWS behavior is verified.

import { DynamoDBClient, GetItemCommand, PutItemCommand, UpdateItemCommand, DeleteItemCommand } from '@aws-sdk/client-dynamodb';

const SLUG = 'lambda-powertools-idempotency-ts';

/**
 * Runs the purchased DynamoDB-backed helper with a local AWS SDK command fixture.
 * The fixture keeps table state in memory and never sends a request to AWS.
 */
export async function preview({ configuration, selected_components } = {}) {
  if (!configuration || configuration.language !== 'javascript'
      || typeof configuration.table_name !== 'string'
      || typeof configuration.event_key_jmespath !== 'string'
      || !Array.isArray(selected_components) || selected_components.length !== 1
      || selected_components[0] !== 'base') {
    return { ok: false, status: 'invalid', slug: SLUG, operation_count: 0, diagnostic_codes: ['configuration_invalid'] };
  }
  const records = new Map();
  const keyFor = key => JSON.stringify(Object.fromEntries(Object.entries(key ?? {}).map(([name, value]) => [name, value.S ?? value.N ?? ''])));
  const client = new DynamoDBClient({ region: 'us-east-1', credentials: { accessKeyId: 'local-preview', secretAccessKey: 'local-preview' } });
  client.send = async command => {
    const input = command.input;
    if (command instanceof GetItemCommand) return { Item: records.get(keyFor(input.Key)) };
    if (command instanceof PutItemCommand) { const keyName = input.ExpressionAttributeNames['#id']; const key = keyFor({ [keyName]: input.Item[keyName] }); if (records.has(key)) { const error = new Error('ConditionalCheckFailedException'); error.name = 'ConditionalCheckFailedException'; error.Item = records.get(key); throw error; } records.set(key, input.Item); return {}; }

      const key = keyFor(input.Key), item = { ...(records.get(key) ?? input.Key) };
      for (const [, name, value] of input.UpdateExpression.matchAll(/#([A-Za-z0-9_]+)\s*=\s*:([A-Za-z0-9_]+)/g)) {
        const attribute = input.ExpressionAttributeNames[`#${name}`];
        item[attribute] = input.ExpressionAttributeValues[`:${value}`];
      }
      records.set(key, item); return {};
    }
    if (command instanceof DeleteItemCommand) { records.delete(keyFor(input.Key)); return {}; }
    throw new Error('preview_command_unsupported');
  };
  try {
    let calls = 0;
    const wrapped = makeDynamoIdempotent(async event => { calls++; return { order_id: event.body.orderId, accepted: true }; }, configuration, { awsSdkV3Client: client });
    const event = { body: { orderId: 'protected-preview' } };
    const context = { getRemainingTimeInMillis() { return 30000; } };
    const first = await wrapped(event, context);
    const second = await wrapped(event, context);

  } catch {

  } finally {

","mime_type":"text/javascript","path":"preview.source.mjs","sha256":"a32bb157a0462d73550570faba987b5df2254d42300658cba78466f0336f47e8","size_bytes":3249},{"content":"# Powertools Idempotency for Lambda (TypeScript/JavaScript)

Wrap a Lambda business handler with the actual Powertools Idempotency utility and DynamoDB persistence layer. Choose a stable business key in the event (such as `body.orderId`); Lambda request IDs change across retries and are unsuitable as idempotency keys.

## Install and use

Install these exact direct versions: Powertools Idempotency 2.36.0 and AWS SDK DynamoDB client 3.1156.0. Run Node.js 20 or newer in Lambda. Create a DynamoDB table with a string partition key named `id`; the Lambda role needs `dynamodb:GetItem`, `PutItem`, `UpdateItem`, and `DeleteItem` on that table.

```js
import { makeDynamoIdempotent } from './src/idempotency.mjs';

async function chargeOrder(event) {
  const { orderId, amount } = event.body;
  return chargeCustomer({ orderId, amount, idempotencyKey: orderId });
}
export const handler = makeDynamoIdempotent(chargeOrder, {
  table_name: process.env.IDEMPOTENCY_TABLE,
  event_key_jmespath: 'body.orderId',
  payload_validation_jmespath: 'body.[customerId,amount,currency]',
  expires_after_seconds: 3600,
});
```

Powertools stores the completed response in DynamoDB and can replay it for a duplicate. It cannot make an external payment provider atomic with DynamoDB. If the provider succeeds and Lambda fails before the idempotency result is persisted, a retry may call the provider again. Pass the same business key to a provider that supports idempotency and reconcile uncertain outcomes.

## Native private preview and boundary

`preview.mjs` runs the real Powertools DynamoDB persistence layer and idempotency wrapper twice using real AWS SDK command objects whose `send` method is replaced with a fixed in-memory DynamoDB command fixture. The fixture exercises local idempotency logic and duplicate replay; it does not contact or verify DynamoDB, durable storage, IAM, or cross-Lambda coordination. The result carries `local_fixture_only` for this reason.

import { DynamoDBPersistenceLayer } from '@aws-lambda-powertools/idempotency/dynamodb';

const TABLE = /^[A-Za-z0-9_.-]{3,255}$/;

export function makeDynamoIdempotent(handler, {
  table_name,
  event_key_jmespath,
  expires_after_seconds = 3600,
  payload_validation_jmespath,
} = {}, { awsSdkV3Client } = {}) {
  if (typeof handler !== 'function') throw new Error('handler_required');
  if (typeof table_name !== 'string' || !TABLE.test(table_name)) throw new Error('invalid_table_name');
  if (typeof event_key_jmespath !== 'string' || !event_key_jmespath.trim()) throw new Error('event_key_jmespath_required');
  if (!Number.isSafeInteger(expires_after_seconds) || expires_after_seconds < 1 || expires_after_seconds > 31536000) {
    throw new Error('invalid_expiration');
  }
  const persistenceStore = new DynamoDBPersistenceLayer({ tableName: table_name, ...(awsSdkV3Client ? { awsSdkV3Client } : {}) });
  const config = new IdempotencyConfig({
    eventKeyJmesPath: event_key_jmespath,
    expiresAfterSeconds: expires_after_seconds,
    ...(payload_validation_jmespath ? { payloadValidationJmesPath: payload_validation_jmespath } : {}),
    throwOnNoIdempotencyKey: true,
  });
  return makeIdempotent(handler, { persistenceStore, config });
}
